fsm_states_link.name: Down
fsm_states_link.description: Link electrically idle / not trained. Entered after reset or on unrecoverable link error.

fsm_states_link.name: Training
fsm_states_link.description: NVHS lanes acquire bit/symbol lock, per-sub-link lane de-skew, and lane-to-link alignment ('brick' = 8 lane pairs/direction). PAM4 (Gen4) additionally adapts the four-level eye.

fsm_states_link.name: Active
fsm_states_link.description: Normal operation: flits (16-byte) carrying read/write/atomic transactions flow in both directions; per-flit CRC checked; replay on error.

fsm_states_link.name: Sleep / Low-Power
fsm_states_link.description: Link in a low-power state; sub-link may be in electrical idle; exit re-trains/realigns before resuming traffic.

fsm_states_link.name: Recover / Retrain
fsm_states_link.description: On excessive CRC/replay or lane degradation, the link retrains; a failing lane may be deconfigured, narrowing the link.

fsm_states_flit_transmitter.name: TX_FORM
fsm_states_flit_transmitter.description: Packetize a read/write/atomic transaction (header + data) into one or more 16-byte flits.

fsm_states_flit_transmitter.name: TX_CRC
fsm_states_flit_transmitter.description: Compute the per-flit CRC and append it.

fsm_states_flit_transmitter.name: TX_SEND
fsm_states_flit_transmitter.description: Stripe the flit across the sub-link's differential lane pairs; NVHS PHY serializes (NRZ Gen1-3 / PAM4 Gen4).

fsm_states_flit_transmitter.name: TX_REPLAY
fsm_states_flit_transmitter.description: Hold transmitted flits in the replay buffer until acknowledged; retransmit on a replay request.

fsm_states_flit_receiver.name: RX_ALIGN
fsm_states_flit_receiver.description: De-skew the lane pairs of the sub-link and reassemble the 16-byte flit.

fsm_states_flit_receiver.name: RX_CRC
fsm_states_flit_receiver.description: Recompute and verify the per-flit CRC.

fsm_states_flit_receiver.name: RX_REPLAY_REQ
fsm_states_flit_receiver.description: On CRC mismatch, request replay of the corrupted flit; good flits are acknowledged.

fsm_states_flit_receiver.name: RX_DELIVER
fsm_states_flit_receiver.description: Deliver the reassembled transaction to the transaction layer (memory read/write/atomic engine).

fsm_hints.trigger: Reset/power-up triggers Down -> Training; successful lane lock + de-skew + alignment reaches Active.
fsm_hints.rule: Every transmitted flit is held in the replay buffer until acknowledged; a CRC failure at the receiver triggers a replay request and retransmission.
fsm_hints.abort: Repeated replay failures or lane loss force Recover/Retrain; a permanently failing lane is deconfigured, narrowing the link width/bandwidth.

anti_deadlock_rule: Credit-based / flow-controlled flits (the flit is the flow-control unit) prevent receiver buffer overflow; read responses and write completions are returned so the requester's outstanding-transaction tracking drains, avoiding deadlock between requests and responses.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-up/reset the link starts Down. NVHS lanes train (bit/symbol lock, per-sub-link de-skew, lane-to-link alignment; PAM4 eye adaptation at Gen4), reach Active, then flits carrying read/write/atomic transactions flow with per-flit CRC + replay. Multiple links per GPU train in parallel and aggregate (4/6/12/18 links for P100/V100/A100/H100).

default_ready_state_recommendation.TX_idle: Electrical idle (or idle flits) when no transaction is pending and the link is Active.
default_ready_state_recommendation.RX_idle: Receiver CDR stays locked while Active; low-power when the link is in Sleep.

configurations.name: Single NVLink (1 link)
configurations.description: One dual-simplex link between two endpoints; 40 GB/s (Gen1) or 50 GB/s (Gen2-4) bidirectional.

configurations.name: Aggregated links per GPU
configurations.description: P100 = 4 links (160 GB/s), V100 = 6 (300 GB/s), A100 = 12 (600 GB/s), H100 = 18 (900 GB/s aggregate bidirectional).

configurations.name: NVSwitch fabric
configurations.description: Many links routed through NVLink Switch chips for all-to-all GPU connectivity on a baseboard.

timing_dependency_rule: Each lane recovers its own clock via CDR; the 8 lane pairs of a sub-link are de-skewed before flit reassembly. TX and RX directions are independent (dual-simplex). Link training/alignment must complete before flits flow; PAM4 (Gen4) adds eye-adaptation latency vs NRZ.
